comment: Sample imported-findings file. Use Reports tab -> 'Import findings file' to generate a report without running Burp. status: candidate|confirmed|false_positive; confidence: high|medium|low; test_case: mass_assignment|jwt_confusion|oauth_redirect|introspection.

findings.signal_description: probe field echoed in response; status changed 200 -> 201; response length delta +64 bytes
findings.baseline_request:
POST /api/users HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.example.local
Content-Type: application/json

{"username": "demo", "email": "d@x.y"}
findings.probe_request:
POST /api/users HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.example.local
Content-Type: application/json

{"username": "demo", "email": "d@x.y", "is_admin": true}
findings.remediation: Use explicit field allowlists (DTOs / strong parameters) for every bindable model; reject unknown fields; never bind security-sensitive fields from user input.

findings.signal_description: response length delta +32 bytes when role=admin added
findings.baseline_request:
PUT /api/profile HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.example.local
Content-Type: application/json

{"email": "d@x.y"}
findings.probe_request:
PUT /api/profile HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.example.local
Content-Type: application/json

{"email": "d@x.y", "role": "admin"}

findings.remediation: Pin the expected algorithm server-side; reject alg=none and any algorithm not in the allowlist.
